h2. Description

Three test cases for the Work Orders analytics story (SV-10593) can only be judged by reading the *Story 12 reports in Google Analytics*. QA has no access to Google Analytics, so these three checks are *blocked*. Everything else in the story is tested: the events the Work Orders page sends were checked and *passed*.

[~accountid:STEFAN_ID], could you please let us know which of these applies?
* *These three checks can be set aside for now.* We will close them for this release and pick them up when the reports are available.
* *Or QA can be given a way to read the reports.* For example, read-only (Viewer) access to the Google Analytics property the QA and staging builds send to ({{G-CMYCXL13C9}}) for {{bilal.muzamil@shopview.com}}, or the name of the person who can read the three reports for our test dates.

h2. What we need to test

||#||Check||What the PRD asks||What QA has done||When the report can be read||
|1|Default and saved settings show as separate groups|S12-R12|A brand-new user and the dispatcher opened Board View on *9 Oct 2026*|Now|
|2|Field selection rate is one combined share across all users|S12-R10, S12-R7, S12-R13|Four test users turn fields on/off on *12 and 13 Oct 2026*. Expected: VIN/Serial *50%*, Total price *66.7%*|From *19 Oct 2026*|
|3|Weekly use and density count each user once|S12-R4, S12-R11, S12-R13|Four test users open the page and pick displays and density this week. Expected: List *4*, Tech View *2*, Board View *1*; Compact, Comfortable, Regular *1* each|From *19 Oct 2026*|

h2. What blocks us

* The PRD makes Milos Vasic the owner of these reports, and they live in Google Analytics.
* QA cannot open Google Analytics. A read-only Google key made from the QA lead's account on *12 Oct 2026* showed *no Analytics accounts or properties* for that account.
* No copy of the reports was found elsewhere: not in Confluence, not in Google Drive. PowerTools' Feature Insights also needs a Google sign-in.
